reviews.text: Unfortunately, my dog ​​had a terminal illness, but the care I received was excellent. They provided cremation, euthanasia, a check-up, and even gave us a consultation room to say goodbye to our girl. They allowed us to be present throughout the entire process, including when they put her to sleep. I am so grateful to all the staff for their kindness during such a difficult time. 😢
Excellent service! I've been taking my dogs there for almost three years, and Dr. Norma's care, service, and honesty have earned my complete trust in her and the hospital. I highly recommend it.
Good service and professionalism
Many thanks to Dr. Norma and her team! My puppy recovered from parvovirus 🐶👏🏻✨ They take excellent care of their patients
Very good service

**Terrible experience. I do not recommend this place.**

From the moment I arrived, the service was disappointing. The young man who greeted me at reception (Tuesday afternoon shift) was rude, curt, and completely uninterested. Zero kindness and zero willingness to help.

The consultation was even worse. The veterinarian didn't even introduce herself, and during my cat's examination, she didn't wash her hands or take his temperature. Honestly, I expected a basic clinical examination and a minimum of professionalism, but I didn't get even that.

She told me she couldn't tell me what was wrong with my cat without taking an X-ray and that it was absolutely necessary to sedate him with ketamine to do so. I explained that I could hold him without any problem, but she refused to consider that possibility. I don't question whether an X-ray or sedation might be necessary for certain patients; I question the way it was communicated to me, the lack of explanation, and the absence of an assessment that inspired confidence. Once she denied me the opportunity to hold my cat for the x-ray, she asked me to leave the office without explaining anything or offering any alternative.

A terrible experience from beginning to end: from reception to the consultation.

I left very upset and disappointed. I wouldn't go back and I wouldn't recommend her. And apparently, that's not just my opinion.
24-hour emergency room, good service
They are completely professional, dedicated, and kind. They cared for our cat like no one else and saved him. I 100% recommend them if you love your animals; they will take good care of them here.
Excellent service for pets and their owners. They explain everything you need to know and help you resolve any doubts. They offer 24/7 service, every day of the year.

I loved the treatment my dog ​​and I received. I went in for an emergency during the night and the doctor took excellent care of us. The facilities are clean and offer many services, including high-quality patient testing.

Excellent veterinary hospital. The staff is highly trained and provides impeccable care. They explained everything perfectly, giving very clear instructions and observations for my pet's care. Without a doubt, a completely trustworthy place. Highly recommended!

Excellent service, I highly recommend them. The staff is very kind and friendly; their passion for their profession is evident, and the prices are reasonable. They explain every condition your pets might have perfectly and, of course, do everything in their power to help them in the best way possible. 🫶🏽
I will definitely continue to take my pets there.
We were treated very well, even though we went in an emergency in the early hours of the morning, they attended to us quickly and everything fortunately turned out very well.
Good service from the night shift
Terrible service, very poor customer service; you have to beg for appointments, information, and test results. You make an appointment and they see you more than an hour later.

I received very professional, compassionate, and high-quality care at this hospital. The professionals there are highly skilled and provide care tailored to the needs and requests of the patients. Excellent service.
Very good service

I really appreciated the way they treated the pets, especially my own. I'm very grateful to the night shift staff and the doctor for their attention and the information they provided me throughout! Highly recommended!
It says it's a 24-hour emergency room, and I got tired of knocking at 1 a.m. I could hear the doctors laughing in the back. If you have an emergency, avoid this place.

I took my kitten to the vet, and they charged me an exorbitant price and wouldn't listen to me. They gave him the wrong treatment.
In the end, I took him to another vet, and he cured my kitten.

Very friendly, affordable prices.

And excellent service.

The doctors are truly excellent; they always make my dog ​​Luna recover. Dr. Nayeli is very professional, as is Dr. Jaime! I wholeheartedly recommend them. Luna has been with them for six years, and they keep her records in perfect order!

Excellent care from all the staff, doctors, and receptionists.
I took my kitten in for panleukopenia, and they pulled him through in just a few days. Dr. Denise saw him and made a quick and accurate diagnosis, and she treated us very well as his owners. The veterinarians on duty provided excellent follow-up care, very thorough and clear reports, and were very kind.

The prices also seemed very reasonable for all the treatment he received.
Thank you so much for helping my kitten. I highly recommend them.

I went there for an emergency, and they did treat my dog, but the way they treated him and their methods were incredibly archaic. I had to participate in the process without knowing anything about it, and I watched my little one suffer unnecessarily. Finally, when they gave me the bill, the prices were outrageous! If you have an emergency and there's no other option, go there because they'll treat you, but I would never recommend them!
Terrible. I don't understand why they claim to handle emergencies 24 hours a day when they're not equipped to do so. I wouldn't recommend it if you need an emergency at night.

Excellent place for my cats; they've received wonderful care and have given me diagnoses that other places couldn't tell me what was wrong with them. The doctors are very professional. It's fantastic that they have 24-hour emergency care.

I had a terrible experience at this place. I took my kitten in for a chafing issue. It had to be an emergency because it was early Sunday morning and my regular vet doesn't offer 24-hour service. They took him in for an examination without letting me accompany them, and once I was allowed in, they wanted him hospitalized due to a "neurological" problem. The bill was obviously going to be exorbitant because of the "materials" and medications they might use. They rudely told me I had to bring him in for treatment because what my kitten had couldn't be treated at home. Today, my kitten is perfectly fine, thanks to the home care his regular vet gave us. The "doctors" insisted it was a neurological issue because he wasn't walking properly. Obviously, if he had chafing, he wasn't going to walk correctly. It's a shame they have these kinds of situations. Perhaps the doctors are on commission, and that's why they want to do and sell things our pets don't really need.

The staff is very friendly and empathetic; they explain things in clear language, have a sense of urgency, and follow up on your case. Definitely the best veterinary clinic/hospital I've ever been to. Highly recommended :)

My kitten had panleukopenia, and Dr. Yessica kept him alive.
I had no hope he would survive, but he did.
They were always very empathetic and clear with us, and my little baby is alive and well, and today I took him home.

Thank you.

The values ​​of Shuncu Vet Hospital (transparency, honesty, and empathy) are lived intensely every day with joy and passion. The team of professionals at this wonderful place shares the concern and sensitivity of patients and owners, making the hospital the right place to seek help. God bless them.

If you want to avoid a misdiagnosis and wasting money, and then not even getting an apology when they make a mistake, don't come to this place.

A few months ago, we brought my dog ​​in for a consultation and check-up. They did lab work and X-rays, and he left with medication for a UTI and a follow-up appointment for a back problem. We asked several questions about his health, but according to the doctor, named Norma, she recommended physical therapy and an expensive medication to continue with, and said everything was fine. A few months passed, and he was fine until he started looking lethargic, walking hunched over, and breathing heavily. Based on the previous diagnosis, we thought it was back pain, so I took him back for another appointment. They supposedly examined him, and again, the same doctor recommended the same thing. We ordered the medication for his back on a Tuesday; it was supposed to arrive in 2 to 3 days, and they gave him gabapentin again for the pain (because they don't seem to know any other medication)... My dog ​​continued to be unwell; the medication wasn't working... He stopped eating, didn't want to pee anymore, etc. Friday arrived and they never called to check if the medication had arrived. Early Saturday morning, I contacted them on their phone number, which doesn't work, until I finally got through on WhatsApp. It turned out that, by "mistake," they had ordered the medication just on Friday (I could swear they hadn't even ordered it). The vet's attitude completely changed. I told her it was urgent that my dog ​​be treated because he looked very ill... And she didn't even apologize for the "mistake." Instead, she completely changed her attitude and, very rudely, told me on the phone that "the medication doesn't work like magic anyway," that my dog ​​was already very sick, and that it wasn't guaranteed... 🤦🏻‍♀️ They said that if he was already in that condition, he needed to be hospitalized to stabilize him, and they would send me the hospital admission estimate... Fortunately, they refunded the money for the medication, and even more fortunate that I didn't take him there to spend his last hours... Based on several recommendations, we ended up at a clinic in the 2nd section of Tlatelolco, where the doctors were wonderfully humane. They ran tests and saw that my dog ​​was already very ill, and we had to put him to sleep... My frustration, anger, and sadness stem from the fact that the veterinarian told me that the lab tests they had done months earlier showed that my dog ​​had kidney problems and that his illness was also cardiac... So here at SHUNCU VET, they NEVER SEE HIM DESPITE RUNNING TESTS. Maybe my dog ​​was already sick, but he wouldn't have deteriorated so much in such a short time, and he wouldn't have suffered so much in his last days waiting for medication that wasn't even meant to alleviate what he had... 🥺🥺😔😭
Very humane and very professional.
Excellent service for my dog, but very poor logistical management. We scheduled an appointment and were made to wait almost 2 HOURS. There were customers who arrived later and were seen before.

My dog ​​arrived with stomach pain and vomiting, having gone three days without eating. We didn't know where to take him, so we searched online and found Shuncu Vet. The doctor who saw us in the emergency room was very kind and gentle with our dog. She made us feel confident. The next day, Dr. Jessica was also very kind and helpful, and our dog left safe and sound.

Pompeyo was treated very well in his final days 🥹
Their service is very good; they offer most services, including studies and cremation—everything is fine. …
Excellent service from all the staff, accurate, honest, and they explain everything about the treatment and condition.
This is a very comprehensive hospital; they have many tools to help you arrive at an accurate diagnosis. They have a lot of patients, so schedule your appointments well in advance.
Don't forget to bring your INE (National Electoral Institute ID) because otherwise they will deny you services
Excellent service, my kittens are treated very well, especially Dr. Norma.

I came to them through a recommendation from my veterinarian, and thankfully they provided excellent treatment for one of my pets who was very ill. The veterinarians and staff are kind and attentive despite the large number of pets they see.

A special thank you to Dr. Norma, who helped stabilize my pet and perform the necessary surgery promptly. Today, my dog ​​is improving tremendously. Thanks to her professionalism, I feel confident that the recommendation was very good; it would definitely be a place I would call on for an emergency.

The only ones worthwhile there are two doctors! Dr. Lydia and Dr. Triano, the orthopedist! ... They're very unpunctual, the reception is incredibly slow when it comes to billing, payment, giving information, etc. ... And getting a response on WhatsApp? Ugh! 🤦🏻‍♀️ ... 👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻 …

Terrible place, starting with the receptionist on the afternoon shift who does whatever she wants. You ask for your bill at one time and they end up giving it to you three hours later. They keep the animals alive and suffering instead of being honest and telling you they won't make it. They charge you for medications without explaining what they're for, and they don't give you any health reports; you practically have to beg for information.
Excellent service from the staff

The service is friendly until they mention the costs, which are EXCESSIVELY EXPENSIVE. They charge for everything separately on top of what they're already charging (consultation, etc.). Since it was way out of our budget, they gave me back my kitten, but they made me sign a voluntary surrender form, and the vet made a comment like, "If you're not going to follow up, just have him humanely euthanized." They will follow up, but after reading all the reviews and seeing the costs, this isn't the best option.
Good service, a little slow for emergencies at night, but excellent care, good veterinarians, very empathetic.
I loved the service; they're attentive, professional, and the service is fantastic. The prices aren't cheap, but the results are worth it.

Excellent service
The doctors on duty at night are very kind
Excellent veterinarians, very professional and empathetic.

Hello,

I'd like to make a reservation. Do you have a link to book you through Agendaly.com?
Highly recommended! This vet has always saved my pets and others too. They are very warm, caring, and professional. If you're looking for excellent service, this is the place!
Good service
They wouldn't sell me a can of food because it was already night.
Excellent in EVERY way! Service, attention, from reception to the doctors, impeccable facilities, highly recommended! THANK YOU!
They don't give a confirmed diagnosis, they just prescribe medications like spaghetti stuck to a wall, hoping one will stick.

I don't recommend them. They gave a wrong diagnosis, suggested unnecessary procedures and expenses, and didn't send the service records (in my case, X-rays and ultrasound) for my pet to my email or any other address. I paid $1500 for a supposed service receipt. That was it.

Highly recommended. We went there for an emergency with my dog ​​in the middle of the night. The service was excellent. A very safe and clean place. The explanation of what they did and the care they gave my dog ​​was top-notch.
Very friendly and attentive staff who explain in detail what is happening to your pet; very professional
Thank you so much!! Very professional and empathetic. Thank you so much for your care of our puppy (Hugo) ❤️🙏 …

Terrible service. You schedule appointments and then, at the last minute, they don't appear in the system.

Or you have your appointment and they leave you waiting for more than two hours.

We brought our 3 kg Chihuahua in for a checkup, and when we left, four "veterinarians" handed him back with a bandage on his paw because they hadn't handled him properly and had broken a nail at the base. The worst part was that they told us to bring him back for another checkup, but of course, they wanted to charge us for the consultation. We went in for one thing and left with two. Greed got the better of them. What a shame. I never plan to return. It's not possible to give zero stars or even negative ones, because I would.

This hospital is excellent. They cured my dog, something another vet couldn't do, and they brought him back to health. I highly recommend Dr. Jessica and all her staff; they're very kind. Although many say they take a while, it's true, but that's because they examine the animals so thoroughly, and it's worth the wait.

A week after taking my dog ​​to this place, she passed away. And what hurts me the most isn't just losing her, but knowing that she spent her last days not with us, with her family, but hospitalized in a place where they never told us the truth.

She was hospitalized for three days. During all that time, they never gave us a clear diagnosis or explained how serious her condition really was. We had to beg for the test results via WhatsApp, and even then, they took a long time to send them. The owner told me to message him on WhatsApp with any questions, but they never answered. When they did, the only response was to bring her back. The customer service is terrible.

In desperation, we decided to take her to another veterinarian. This one was humane. He spoke to us honestly: he told us that my dog ​​didn't have much hope of living, that he didn't recommend any more tests or hospitalization, and that the best thing we could do for her was to take her home and be with her.

Those three days she spent hospitalized, away from us, scared, could have been three days with her family, receiving love. But just to charge for hospitalization, they never told us the truth.

If for any reason you decide to bring your pet here and have them hospitalized, bring your own kibble or food to save yourself an unnecessary expense.

Very expensive and completely inhumane. Our pets are family, and they deserve to be treated with dignity and honesty. Speaking the truth, even if it hurts, will always be better than profiting from the pain of those who only want the best for their beloved companion. I do not recommend it.
24-hour service, very attentive to our pets, they have an on-site x-ray machine, quite complete for handling emergencies

My furry friends and I highly recommend them. All the doctors are so kind, attentive, and professional. The place is very clean, they treat our little ones well, and they're with you every step of the way, making you feel very confident. 🤗🐾 …
They were very kind to me, the doctor who treated me was very courteous and treated my dog ​​very well ☺️
Good service, reliability and good treatment.
Very poor service. They don't have trained staff to calm nervous pets, their prices are exorbitant, and they require unnecessary tests. Not recommended at all.

Three years ago, my kitten had a very serious accident. After going to three other vets, this place finally had everything they needed to treat him. Unfortunately, it was very difficult, and there wasn't much hope. We ultimately had to put my kitten (Pekopeko) to sleep, but the vet who treated him was very kind and empathetic. Putting him to sleep was the saddest thing that has ever happened to me, but they gave us the space to say goodbye. It hurts so much that I didn't bring him here from the beginning and that he went through so much pain, but I'm grateful because in the end, I think Pekopeko was able to stop suffering. Please continue to take care of your pets. 😢

Excellent service from the medical team during evening hours. I went in for a minor issue with my dog, but they were extremely efficient and understanding. The facilities are modern and clean—the best veterinary hospital I've seen in the area.
The only veterinary hospital in Lindavista. The care and professionalism they provide to pets is top-notch. They have everything necessary for routine checkups or emergencies.
Very good 24 hours

Definitely the best place to take your pets. My dog ​​Milo was admitted as an emergency on a Sunday and they attended to him quickly. He was hospitalized for about four days, and each doctor followed up with me and was very kind in explaining his prescriptions, medications, and the continuation of his treatments. While he was hospitalized, they answered any questions I had about my little guy. The reception staff was excellent. It's worth noting that when many patients arrive at once, there's a wait, but they always give you priority. It's also important to empathize with the work each person there does. Finally, I highly recommend Dr. Yésica Castillo Guzmán and Dr. Nayeli Santiago Alejandro, who were the two main doctors who cared for my boy. In general, whoever treated him was also very kind and pleasant. 🥰

Excellent for emergencies, 24/7 care, and very kind and caring specialists with patients and follow-up. It's just a bit expensive in terms of consultations and medications, but it's highly recommended for all our furry friends and cats, and there's even a day for bird lovers.

A very good option for any nighttime care. The facilities are very nice and clean. Prices are reasonable and available at reception.

Care is provided according to the triage protocol and in order of arrival. The attending physician is very friendly and clear in her instructions.
An excellent veterinarian. With very good doctors. Fast treatments and tests. 24-hour service.

Excellent place!!
I took my kitten there with a very bleak prognosis. From the moment I arrived, they treated us very well and were very kind.

I am eternally grateful to Dr. Norma; she's the one who pulled my girl through. It's been a long process, but that's because of how complicated my kitten's health was. Now I can say that we're just about to be discharged. My kitten is doing very well. Thank you so much, Dr. Norma!!
The reception staff were very friendly, the facilities were spotless, and the prices are reasonable for the area.
Shuncuvet, keep up the good work, training your veterinarians and providing such excellent care. I highly recommend you! 🌻🌻

I took my kitten to Shuncu Vet Veterinary Hospital because of an intestinal obstruction, and the care was excellent. From the beginning, he was seen by Dr. Nayeli, who handled his case with great professionalism and dedication.

Although she was only available on weekends, the entire medical team was always attentive to my kitten. They were all fully aware of his condition and the treatment he was receiving, and they were always very kind to both the pets and us, the owners.

They clearly explained the treatment options and the risks of each procedure to us. During his stay at the hospital, they kept us informed every time we visited him.

We are very grateful for their attention, clarity, and compassionate care.

Highly recommended! The service is excellent, the care is superb. We took my pet in very bad shape; we thought we were going to die. And after being hospitalized for a few days, they returned him to us as good as new.

Many thanks to Dr. Norma and to each member of the medical and administrative staff who supported us during this process.

In my experience, it's a great place to take care of your little ones. The receptionist is very friendly and has a lovely personality. The doctors who treated my pet were very tactful and empathetic, and my little one improved a lot with the treatment they prescribed. ✨☺️

I don't recommend it. Most of the veterinarians have zero empathy for pet owners; they seem to care more about money than your pet's health. If you have the opportunity to take your pet there, don't take it.

They helped me feel more at ease with the correct diagnosis for my kitten. I went to two other vets, but they didn't have the equipment to do the necessary tests, and here I didn't have to transfer her afterward. ⭐️🥺 …
They don't answer the phone. I called several times to avoid taking my cat to an enclosed space, and there's no response.

A very bad experience. They need to be more empathetic. When someone requests a service, it's because they need to be with experts. The nurses hurt the dog, and instead of compensating for the damage, they charged even more. And the hospital is getting more expensive compared to a year ago. It's their business, but there are abuses within it. Charging 11,000 for a surgery when four other veterinary clinics charge between 3,000 and 5,000 for the same procedure is outrageous.
The best of the best, very humane, they know what they're doing, they keep you informed, and they treat our puppies with the same importance as a person. 10/10

They were very kind, the place is very clean, and it seems they have almost everything essential in a hospital; they just don't have their own lab, but they do have imaging services and an operating room. And the veterinarian who treated my dog ​​explained everything to me in detail. 👌🏻 …

Excellent service.

I brought my badly injured cat in, and unfortunately, we had to make the decision to euthanize him. The veterinarian who treated us was very empathetic and professional throughout the entire process.

Before performing any procedure, she consulted with us and explained the costs involved to obtain our consent.

The veterinarian knew exactly what she was doing. She clearly explained my cat's condition to us, but always with tact. She gave us the options and was very realistic.

The receptionist is one of the kindest people I've ever met.

Good service.
Very attentive.

In just one month, I've had emergency care with positive results. Dr. Norma is incredibly compassionate and communicates very effectively. My dog ​​went through a very difficult procedure, but when she was discharged, she looked fantastic despite the trauma she endured. Thank you for everything.

Save yourself the trouble of going at night if you want to be treated poorly by rude, arrogant staff who act like they're doing you a favor. If you're buying food or urgent medication at night, forget about it. They only cater to "patients." Check the staff; I understand hiring interns, but at least make sure the customer service is good. Explain to them that most of the customers at night are emergencies. The receptionist was terrible—rude, conceited, and arrogant. That's just my experience, and I see why they have such a bad rating. If I had read the comments here beforehand, I would have avoided the rudeness and mistreatment at this establishment.
Excellent service, they are very affectionate with the dogs.
Thank you for saving my beautiful cat after I rushed him in following his fall from several floors. All the doctors were incredibly professional and kind. 🐥 …

I had to take my dog ​​in for a very difficult situation, and unfortunately, I had to make the painful decision to euthanize her. From the moment we arrived at the hospital, the care was excellent. All the staff, from the receptionist to the emergency room doctors, were very attentive and professional.

The doctor who treated us was incredibly empathetic and respectful, explaining each step clearly and supporting me throughout the entire process, while also giving me the space I needed. He made sure to be transparent about the costs before any procedure and made me feel safe and understood during such a delicate time.

Furthermore, the hospital has all the necessary equipment to provide high-quality veterinary care, which gave me a lot of confidence. Without a doubt, it is a highly recommended veterinary hospital for its professionalism, compassionate care, and exceptional attention to patients and their owners.
Excellent service, they always treat Keizy very well.

We went to an emergency service in the early hours of the morning and the service was quick, they are honest and empathetic to the pain one is going through, they have good facilities and affordable prices.

The staff at this hospital are very kind and efficient! I took my wolf, Apollo, in very serious condition, and I noticed a few things: the hospital was very clean, the cages spotless, and the bedding soft and clean. They use infusion pumps to better control the fluids administered intravenously to prevent blockages. Most importantly, their gentle and dignified treatment of their patients is truly appreciated.

Many thanks to all the staff, and especially to Dr. Cristhian!
The doctor was excellent and very helpful. It was 3 am when I took my dog ​​in and they treated him very well. They really know what they're doing.

Excellent service from all the staff. The doctors were very professional and kind. I took my baby in for an emergency and they attended to her quickly, explaining the procedures the whole time. Thank you so much. 🙏💯 …
Very professional, friendly, and helpful. They provide all the necessary information.

Without a doubt, one of the best hospitals in Mexico City and Lindavista. I have a pug, and she's been well cared for by their doctor; the medical results have been excellent.
Greetings from Katerine 🫰 …

Overall, it was good. We went for some plates and everything was fine, good service. The service at reception was perhaps a little slow. They say they have parking, but it's small (understandably, given the area) and it's on a busy street. However, I think the cars parked there belong to the doctors. It's better to leave it in the plaza.

My comment is meant to say that I felt like I was at the IMSS (Mexican Social Security Institute)...it's true my dog ​​wasn't as sick as some of the other animals, but seeing your pet's sadness and lack of movement is worrying. Right away they told me, "We're attending to an emergency and it's going to take a while," and I said I'd wait. Half an hour later the vet came out and said, "It's going to take a loooong time, and if another emergency patient arrives, I'll see them first. I hope you understand." I left discreetly; I wouldn't go back there.

Excellent service. They take great care of pets, and if there's an emergency, they give it priority. Of course, remember that just because our pets are sick doesn't mean everything is a priority. I also noticed that if they already have a lot of patients, they let you know so you can decide whether to wait or not, or they simply inform you that they can't see you. And it doesn't matter if the doctor who saw you first isn't there; everyone knows your pet's condition. That's excellent—10/10 service.
Excellent service and I highly recommend this place as they are very good doctors and very kind throughout the entire process

This vet clinic is fantastic! I've had a great experience there, and it's become my go-to place. Dr. Norma is a true professional. I always choose her for my dogs; she saved my dog ​​from a stroke. The only thing that could be improved is the reception area. All the paperwork and signatures can slow down the service, and sometimes there are 5 or 6 patients waiting, which can take up to 30 minutes. Aside from that, everything is great.

Excellent service
Excellent facilities
With dedicated and specialized staff
They helped my dog
I highly recommend them
Good medical care, nice facilities, but prices aren't very affordable. I took my cat there and I liked it; I'll keep taking her.
Excellent service and follow-up
Excellent clinic! Dr. Daniel is very kind and professional with pets and their owners.

Good service.
Dr. Jaime is a very good doctor. I took my kitten to him in the middle of the night because he was attacked by dogs. The doctor treated him and was very attentive. Excellent service.

I took my dog ​​in for an emergency and the treatment was appropriate.
The staff is very kind and attentive. Good experience.
Excellent service

Excellent medical care. My dog ​​arrived with a severe gastrointestinal problem and is now well controlled. They also have everything necessary. I highly recommend Dr. Norma, an excellent veterinarian with a passion for her work and her patients.
We had an emergency and the care was excellent. Thank you!
Excellent service

We went there for the 24-hour service. Seeing the diagnostic care at other hospitals, I now understand why they never "got" what was wrong with my dog ​​here; they just charged us for seeing him.
Besides, they always had a bad attitude. I don't know if it was because of the shift or if they're always like that.
The last time we went, they were more interested in their meeting than attending to the emergency, and they only examined the dog (which makes you wonder). When I heard him "crying," I asked them to take him out, and they said the doctor would arrive in 20 minutes because he was stuck in traffic. When he arrived, they told me the doctor was changing to go into the examination room and that he'd be here in 5 minutes. Obviously, I took my dog ​​and decided never to go back.
This is a place that truly cares about pets; it's open 24 hours a day and is always an excellent option for emergencies.

The service was awful. I brought my parakeet, and the receptionist rudely told me they didn't accept those kinds of animals, even though their logo features a bird! That's lying to the public. I wasted my time.

The care is excellent, they have the best equipment, and it's very expensive for most people... but I know that for many, their pet is part of the family... but they can consult with other veterinarians.
I highly recommend them, as they provide excellent service from the moment we arrived until we left. Very good service.
The hospital is clean, they treated me very well, especially Dr. Cristian, who was very patient and explained in detail what was wrong with my dog. I highly recommend this place.
100% recommended, very good service
Excellent service, attention and kindness 🙏 …
Excellent service.
Excellent service 👌 …
Excellent service, 100% recommended
Excellent service

Excellent service! I must highlight the courteous and professional treatment, the clean facilities, and the adequate equipment. Most importantly, their efficiency and kind treatment of our pets. Highly recommended.
We received excellent and prompt service from both the person who greeted us and the doctor; both were very kind and professional.
Excellent service.
Excellent service 🐕‍🦺 …

They took great care of my kitten 😊
Thank you ❤️😻 …
The best, by far... they always take the best care of my pets 💜 …
Excellent care for my pet, I highly recommend this clinic.
Excellent service, very professional.
Excellent service 👌🏿 …
Excellent service! Very kind and professional people who take care of you from beginning to end! I highly recommend them.
My cat received such lovely treatment. Thank you!
Highly recommended hospital. Excellent service, with highly trained professionals.
